detail_text: Specifically, the firm failed to adequately conduct and document investigations regarding the use of the API Baclofen in the production of prescription drug products which had been recalled by two of their suppliers for different reasons: A. Attix Pharmaceuticals API Baclofen USP, lot 131009 in powdered form was used in the production of at least'(b)(<' prescriptions/ lots from 4/ 9/ 14 and 10/ 9/15 including but not limited to baclofen suspension and baclofen topical cream lots 04092014@13, 08182014@2, 12222014@13, 02022015@22, 04092015@10, 09222015@8, 10092015@2. The firm received a recall letter from Attix Pharmaceuticals faxed to them on 3/ 25/ 15 stating that all lots of all pre-packaged products were being recalled for possible exposure to penicillin products since January 5, 2012. According to the Pharmacist, the firm pulled the API Baclofen, lot 131009 from their inventory but they did not document the quantity on hand nor the amount and date of the destruction of the lot by their third- party contractor Guarantee Returns. They did not conduct an investigation into what prescription drug products were produced from API Baclofen, lot 131009 and whether to notify physicians and/ or patients of the risks or to have the drug products returned and destroyed. B. Medisca API Baclofen USP, lot 125184/C in powdered form, manufactured by Taizhou Xinyou Pharmaceutical & Chemical Co., Ltd., was used in the production of REDACTED [redacted] prescriptions/lots between 10/12/15 and 12/23/15 including but not limited to baclofen suspension and baclofen topical cream lots 10122015@5, 10262015@27 and 12232015@7. According to the pharmacist, the firm pulled a partial REDACTED [redacted] bottle (actual quantity unknown) from their shelf after receiving the Medisca recall notification which was faxed to them on 12/23/15 indicating the product was being recalled for possible endotoxins and microorganisms. Lot 125184/C was used to manufacture the baclofen suspension identified in MedWatch report 11801434, however the firm did not document their investigation into this drug product for super potency. Additionally, the firm did not document their Producer of s t e r ile and non- s t e r ile dr ugs investigation of any other batches using the recalled lot of Baclofen.

detail_text: Specifically, there was insufficient data, documentation and evidence to invalidate Out of Specification (OOS) results generated by the Quality Control Laboratory. A. During the 7/2010 release testing of Paremyd (Hydroxyamphetamine HydroBromide and Tropicamide) Ophthalmic Solution lot OF40A all four Tropicamide Assay results failed to meet the REDACTED [redacted] % release specifications. The results were 94.8, 94.6, 94.8 and 94.7%. Re-injection of the original solutions confirmed the results. The OOS results were also confmned when 5 'new sample preparations were made. In response to the OOS results, the QC laboratory made changes to the analytical testing procedures. The standard weight was increased, the sample pipeting volume was increased and a newer HPLC system was used. All of the results obtained from the 5 new sample preparations made with the new changes to the testing procedures were within specifications with a mean assay value of 96.2%. The OOS results were invalidated, even though these initial and retest results were obtained from a validated method that had been in use for over 10 years, the changes to the analytical testing procedures were never validated, and there was no method comparison data to show that the assay method with the changes was superior to the original approved method. There was also no information on whether the OOS initial and retest values were significantly different from the in- specification values obtained after the analytical test procedure was changed. Lot OF40A was released. /
detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, 품질관리 시험실에서 나온 기준 일탈(Out of Specification, OOS) 결과를 무효화할 자료, 문서 및 근거가 충분하지 않았다. A. Paremyd(Hydroxyamphetamine HydroBromide 및 Tropicamide) 점안액 로트 OF40A 의 7/2010 출하시험에서 Tropicamide 함량시험 결과 네 개가 모두 REDACTED [redacted] % 출하 규격에 맞지 않았다. 결과는 94.8, 94.6, 94.8, 94.7% 였다. 원래 용액을 재주입해도 결과가 확인되었다. 5 건의 새 시료 조제에서도 OOS 결과가 확인되었다. OOS 결과에 대응하여 QC 시험실은 분석 시험 절차를 변경했다. 표준품 칭량을 늘리고, 시료 피펫팅 부피를 늘렸으며, 더 새로운 HPLC 시스템을 사용했다. 변경된 시험 절차로 만든 5 건의 새 시료 조제에서 얻은 결과는 모두 규격 이내였고 평균 함량값은 96.2% 였다. 최초 결과와 재시험 결과는 10년 넘게 사용해 온 밸리데이션된 방법으로 얻은 것인데도 OOS 결과가 무효화되었고, 분석 시험 절차의 변경은 밸리데이션된 적이 없으며, 변경된 함량시험법이 원래 승인된 방법보다 우수함을 보여 주는 방법 비교 자료도 없었다. 또한 OOS인 최초값 및 재시험값이 분석 시험 절차를 변경한 뒤 얻은 규격 이내 값과 유의하게 다른지에 대한 정보도 없었다. 로트 OF40A 는 출하되었다. /
